description: This file defines the CRPage class and related classes for managing Chromium page sessions within Playwright, including frame management, event handling, navigation, and emulation features.

classes.name: CRPage
classes.description: Represents a Chromium page within Playwright, managing frames, navigation, emulation, and event handling.

classes.name: FrameSession
classes.description: Manages a session for a specific frame, handling events, navigation, and interactions within that frame.

methods.name: mainFrameSession
methods.description: Returns the main frame session for a given page.

methods.name: _forAllFrameSessions
methods.description: Executes a callback for all frame sessions.

methods.name: _sessionForFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the session associated with a specific frame.

methods.name: _sessionForHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the session associated with a DOM element handle.

methods.name: navigateFrame
methods.description: Navigates a specific frame to a URL.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Updates the extra HTTP headers for all frames.

methods.name: updateGeolocation
methods.description: Updates geolocation settings for all frames.

methods.name: updateOffline
methods.description: Sets the offline mode for network requests.

methods.name: updateHttpCredentials
methods.description: Updates HTTP authentication credentials.

methods.name: updateEmulatedViewportSize
methods.description: Emulates viewport size for the main frame.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the page to the front.

methods.name: updateEmulateMedia
methods.description: Updates media emulation settings.

methods.name: updateUserAgent
methods.description: Updates the user agent string.

methods.name: updateRequestInterception
methods.description: Enables or disables request interception.

methods.name: updateFileChooserInterception
methods.description: Updates file chooser dialog interception.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the page.

methods.name: _go
methods.description: Navigates through browser history.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back in history.

methods.name: goForward
methods.description: Navigates forward in history.

methods.name: requestGC
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds an initialization script to all frames.

methods.name: exposePlaywrightBinding
methods.description: Exposes Playwright binding to frames.

methods.name: removeInitScripts
methods.description: Removes initialization scripts.

methods.name: closePage
methods.description: Closes the page.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the default background color.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the page content.

methods.name: getContentFrame
methods.description: Gets the frame associated with a DOM element.

methods.name: getOwnerFrame
methods.description: Gets the owner frame ID of a DOM element.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Gets the bounding box of a DOM element.

methods.name: scrollRectIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls a rectangle into view if needed.

methods.name: startScreencast
methods.description: Starts screencast recording.

methods.name: stopScreencast
methods.description: Stops screencast recording.

methods.name: rafCountForStablePosition
methods.description: Returns the frame count for stable position.

methods.name: getContentQuads
methods.description: Gets content quads for a DOM element.

methods.name: setInputFilePaths
methods.description: Sets file input paths for a file input element.

methods.name: adoptElementHandle
methods.description: Adopts a DOM element handle into another frame.

methods.name: inputActionEpilogue
methods.description: Performs epilogue actions after input events.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Resets the page for reuse.

methods.name: pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the page.

methods.name: coverage
methods.description: Returns coverage object.

methods.name: getFrameElement
methods.description: Gets the frame element for a frame.

methods.name: shouldToggleStyleSheetToSyncAnimations
methods.description: Indicates if style sheet toggling is needed for animation sync.

methods.name: setDockTile
methods.description: Sets the dock tile image.
